_comment: Written by tools/release/verify-listing-assets.mjs (--write --set mas), normally from the end of a successful packages/desktop/scripts/capture-listing-screenshots.mjs run. Records WHICH BUILD the store listing images depict, which their pixel dimensions cannot say. Do not hand-edit: a pin that was not written by a capture is a claim about a capture nobody watched.

screenshot-home.png.shows: Desktop window, wide Home with the XCHAIN token selected

screenshot-exchange.png.shows: Desktop window, Exchange (DEX) with a market selected

screenshot-my-tokens.png.shows: Desktop window, My Tokens with an issued token selected and its owner actions
